prior_observations_disclosed: All prior fit/audit results already known.
A preliminary read-only count already observed43 unique saved coarse direction witness records,20 selected direction-fit indices,23 original eligible indices.
Per-case component facing SSE and coarse area summaries were already inspected before this protocol; this is not independent confirmation on held-out data.
scope: Reanalyze exactly six frozen HUG development fits and all nine stored audit resolutions. Read existing coarse quadrature for exact coordinate correspondence only. No geometry query, optimizer, simulator, model or inference is run.
methods: Preserve frozen status; report all6parts ×1/2/5mm bands ×all3 numeric allowances for every resolution. Never pool area across overlapping parts/bands.
Deduplicate direction witnesses within one case/resolution by query index,part,flip type; record all observed bands. These are saved witness samples,not exhaustive reversal-site populations.

Coarse membership uses exact index only after identical query-cache SHA and coordinate regression. Fine indices are distinct; report index membershipnull,exact numeric coordinate equality separately,and nearest selected coordinate distance inmm as approximate support only.
Compare facing SSE and exact soft-L1 cost reconstructed from saved facing residuals. No individual robust distance/closest-point cost inferred from SSE.
Original candidate exclusion counts overlap; do not sum. Missing anatomical direction mass remains missing; unavailable is notPASS.
limitations: All cases are inspected development examples,not independent unseen-object validation.
Only capped saved orientation witnesses are individually listed; reported fit coverage is not exhaustive reversal coverage.
Existing query caches are required for replay but are not copied into this portable artifact.
Coordinate equality alone does not imply identical query normal,area,cell or eligibility. Fine nearest-site distances do not establish coverage or orientation validity.
No new geometry is queried; source/body/finger attribution within one anatomical proxy is not inferable from every saved witness.
SSE components are not additive soft-L1 costs. Facing robust cost is recoverable; distance and closest-point separate robust costs are not.
A coverage gap and adverse scalar tradeoff are demonstrated,not a complete correction or global infeasibility proof.
Conditional area lower bounds inherit existing numeric assumptions; anatomical areas overlap and bands are nested. No physical contact-area,failure label or lift claim is made.
